title: Build a field editor directly into a page
description: Let a signed-in customer edit a complaint draft on their dashboard without rebuilding document state or nested field paths.
problem: A customer dashboard needs to edit customer-owned complaint draft fields and nested order details without recreating form state, validation, and path handling.
summary: Create one form controller for the signed-in customer record, then use the public form and field APIs in smaller dashboard components so complaint editing stays consistent.
runtimeNotes: Client-side app surface can target either runtime, but app-user authentication remains application-owned.
intents: build a custom field editor in my app
edit a dyrected document inside a customer dashboard
mount dyrected form state in a customer route
edit nested customer complaint fields without the admin page
